_README: Promoted, tracked copy of the run whose numbers are cited. Regenerate with `python -m crest.analysis.promote_leaderboard --run <run_dir>`. summary.json is NOT a substitute: it lacks the primary endpoint, the provenance and the caveats.

provenance.judge_protocol: full-panel (same-family as covariate); blind; median aggregation

warnings.git_commit_mismatch: run_id encodes b0cdbe7 (git read at run START) but code.git_commit is 754d005 (read again at finalize, ~45min later). HEAD moved mid-run, so this run has TWO provenance values and they disagree. git_info is cached per process now; this run predates that fix.
warnings.judge_prompt_version_absent: All scored records store judge_prompt_version=null: this run predates the stamp. The current prompt is a later version whose rubric differs in ways that move scores, so these numbers are NOT comparable to any run scored under it, and ablate_fields will refuse to ablate against them.

primary_endpoint.definition: min(New, Useful, Surprising), graded on the 1-10 scale

caveats: NO RANKING CLAIM IS MADE. Judge severity spread (3.32/3.20/3.74 per axis) EXCEEDS the between-agent spread (2.06), so the ordering is not identifiable from this run.

r(New, Surprising) = 0.883 record-level / 0.946 pooled is RUBRIC-CONTAMINATED: the v1 judge prompt told the judge the axes correlate at r~0.95. It must not be cited as evidence the axes are inseparable until a v2-scored run exists.

ICC(1,k) = 0.0 / 0.618 / 0.0 (New/Useful/Surprising). The one-way model absorbs judge severity into error. Two-way ICC(3,k) = 0.736 / 0.807 / 0.759, with the judge accounting for 63.2% / 29.0% / 68.2% of variance. Report BOTH; either alone misleads.
ICC(3,*) was added AFTER seeing the data and is EXPLORATORY (see analysis/preregistration.yaml).
Live web retrieval, NOT contamination-controlled. No frozen index exists.

Search budgets are NOT matched across arms: realised searches ran 0.64 (gemini_shallow, with ZERO searches on 40 of its 50 items) to 76.28 (gemini_deepresearch_max, max 144) -- a 119x range, not the 26x an earlier version of this caveat implied by quoting 2.9 (openai_shallow, the second-lowest arm) as the floor. Treat depth as a factor, not as noise.
0 of 250 records carry adapter_fp / truncated / answer_chars / answer_words, so answer-length covariates cannot be computed from this release and the generation cache cannot serve it.
